capabilities: complete note text inline as you type, from an LLM server
accept suggestions whole-line or word-by-word via Tab and Ctrl+→
run instruction-based inline edits on the cursor position or selection
configure server URL, model, subject line, key, and generation parameters
extras: Installation is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from a release into the vault's plugins folder. Failures to reach the server are silent by design; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline completion, and many AI plugins are tied to a specific hosted service rather than a user-chosen local server.

relations.evidence: Needs a server exposing an OpenAI-compatible /v1/completions, plus /v1/chat/completions for inline edit. With llama.cpp:

summary: AI plugin that shows inline text completions from any OpenAI-compatible LLM server and runs instruction-based inline edits in the editor.
